dimensions.name: Concentration Transparency
dimensions.description: Is the vitamin C percentage stated (10%, 15%, 20%)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No concentration. 3: Vague 'high potency'. 5: Concentration range. 7: Exact percentage. 10: Exact percentage with context on why that level was chosen and skin type suitability.

dimensions.name: Form Specificity
dimensions.description: Is the form of vitamin C identified (L-ascorbic acid, SAP, ascorbyl glucoside)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No form. 3: Just 'Vitamin C'. 5: Form named. 7: Form named with benefit. 10: Form named with stability/efficacy explanation and comparison to other forms.

dimensions.name: Ingredient Synergy
dimensions.description: Are supporting ingredients called out (vitamin E, ferulic acid, hyaluronic acid)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No supporting ingredients. 3: One mentioned. 5: 2-3 mentioned. 7: Key synergies explained (CE Ferulic combination). 10: Full ingredient synergy map with why each enhances the vitamin C.

dimensions.name: Skin Type Targeting
dimensions.description: Is suitability for specific skin types stated (oily, dry, sensitive, acne-prone)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No targeting. 3: 'All skin types'. 5: 1-2 types mentioned. 7: Specific type suitability with explanation. 10: Detailed skin type guidance with any contraindications noted.

dimensions.name: Outcome Specificity
dimensions.description: Are specific results promised (dark spots, brightening, collagen boost, sun damage repair)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No outcomes. 3: Generic 'anti-aging'. 5: 1-2 outcomes. 7: Multiple specific outcomes. 10: Specific outcomes with timeline expectations and before/after context.

dimensions.name: Texture & Sensory
dimensions.description: Is product feel described (lightweight, non-greasy, fast-absorbing, no sticky residue)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No texture info. 3: One descriptor. 5: Basic feel. 7: Detailed texture description. 10: Full sensory profile including absorption speed, finish, and under-makeup compatibility.

dimensions.name: Certifications
dimensions.description: Are vegan, cruelty-free, paraben-free, fragrance-free, dermatologist-tested stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: 1 certification. 5: 2-3 certifications. 7: Comprehensive 'free-from' list. 10: Full certification suite with cruelty-free + vegan + clean ingredient positioning.

dimensions.name: Clinical Backing
dimensions.description: Is dermatologist-tested, clinically proven, or clinical study referenced?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: 'Dermatologist approved'. 5: 'Clinically tested'. 7: Specific test methodology. 10: Named clinical study with results data.

dimensions.name: Routine Positioning
dimensions.description: Is where it fits in a skincare routine explained (after toner, before moisturizer)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No guidance. 3: 'Apply to face'. 5: Basic AM/PM. 7: Step-in-routine guidance. 10: Full routine integration with complementary product suggestions.

dimensions.name: Keyword Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the listing include category-relevant search terms present in top competitors?
